title_en: A New Year's Eve Where Everything Went Wrong
note_en: 反而 means "on the contrary, instead": it introduces a result opposite to what was expected. In the text: 结果画蛇添足，汤的颜色变得五颜六色，味道反而比原来差了不少 "he overdid it: the soup turned every color of the rainbow, and actually tasted worse than before" (he meant to improve it). Another: 经过这次教训，爸爸反而成了全家最积极的"安全员" "after that lesson, Dad instead became the family's most zealous 'safety officer.'" 反而 goes before the predicate.
